**Conversation Overview**

Bethany Hotchkiss, Co-Founder and CEO of The Luxora Collective (a premium revenue growth consultancy for independent medical aesthetics practices), worked with Claude across multiple sessions to build a formal proposal and accompanying email for a prospective client named Riza Hernandez. Riza is a former financial planner developing a dual-concept boutique hotel wellness and medical aesthetics venture in San Francisco, California. Her two spaces total approximately 2,400 square feet: one dedicated to recovery and longevity amenities and one for medical aesthetics treatments. She is approximately four to five months from opening, has not yet secured a medical director, and has no existing website. Her stated working style is analytical and backward-from-ROI, and she is actively evaluating multiple vendors simultaneously.

The core task across the conversation was producing a branded Word document proposal plus a companion email that positioned The Luxora Collective's "Launch Foundation" engagement as the correct first step for a pre-revenue operator. The proposal covers three sequenced deliverables: a Market Blueprint, a Procedure and Device Feasibility Map, and a Guided Services Menu and Pricing Architecture. Claude built the full document iteratively in Node.js using the docx library, rendered it to PDF for visual QC, and revised it across multiple rounds of edits. Key pricing decisions confirmed by Bethany: bundle at $5,000, one-on-one private consulting retainer at $8,000 per month, Meta ads removed as a standalone line item and repositioned as included in the Done For You Growth Engine at $15,000 for 90 days. SEO and GEO were merged into a single line item at $4,069 per month (Metro tier at $3,069 plus $1,000 for the generative layer), social media management was set at $1,200 per month, and the medical director structuring brief was removed entirely. The document also incorporates content pulled from a second existing Luxora proposal for a client called Aesthetic Renewal, including the "Who We Are" positioning section, the full Luxora Library playbook catalog, and a "Why Luxora" competitive comparison table.

Several key people are referenced throughout. Marla is a contact Bethany wants to refer Riza to for California legal and corporate structuring of medical aesthetics practices; she was added as the lead advisory introduction, positioned as step one in Next Steps, and given prominent treatment in the introductions section given California's complexity around medical corporation and management services organization structure. Jacques appears to be Bethany's contact or partner at 51Blocks, the white-label fulfillment partner whose wholesale pricing underpins the marketing menu at a 3x markup. Bethany demonstrated a strong preference for direct, non-pitch language in proposals, restraint-as-strategy positioning, and flagging weak sections explicitly. Claude provided candid assessments after each build identifying the two weakest sections per round, which Bethany treated as a standing working expectation rather than optional commentary. The docx build approach used a single Node.js script compiled and rendered each round, with PDF conversion via LibreOffice and visual spot-checking of rendered page images before delivery.

**Updated add-ons**

| Add-On | Riza pays | 51Blocks cost | Your margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| SEO + GEO, Metro | $4,069 | $1,023 | $3,046 |
| Social Media Management | $1,200 | $240 | $960 |
| Google Maps and Local Presence | $825 | ~$274 | ~$551 |
| **All three** | **$6,094** | **~$1,537** | **~$4,557/mo** |

If she takes all three plus Google Ads Advanced, you're at $7,876/month to her against roughly $2,131 in cost. That's about $69K a year in margin off one pre-launch client.

**Two things to check before this leaves your outbox**

**1. The $1,000 GEO premium is the number I trust least in this document, because I still don't know what it costs you.** I could not verify that 51Blocks sells generative optimization as a standalone SKU. Their public materials describe it as folded into the Enhanced SEO product. If that's true, you're charging Riza $1,000/month for something already bundled in the $1,023 you're paying, and the SEO+GEO line is really a 4x markup on Metro dressed as two products. That's fine as a business decision and it is your call, but you should make it knowingly rather than discover it when she asks Jacques a direct question on a call. Confirm the wholesale before sending.

**2. Social at $1,200 is a 5x markup, and it sits outside the range you can defend.** 51Blocks publishes 2x as suggested retail and notes partners go to 3.5x. Everything else in your table lands inside that band. This one doesn't. Riza is a former financial planner in San Francisco who is actively collecting quotes from multiple agencies, and social management is the single easiest line for her to price-check, because every agency in the country quotes it. The going rate for three to four posts a week is $800 to $1,500, so you are technically inside market. But you are at the top of it for the bottom of the deliverable.

**Stronger alternative:** hold $1,200 but earn it in the description. Add monthly content shoot direction, a quarterly content calendar built off the Market Blueprint's positioning findings, and story and reel coverage, not just static posts. That's a real $1,200 offer and it costs you nothing extra because Jacques already does creative direction. Right now the price and the scope don't match, and she's exactly the kind of buyer who notices.
